title: Underwater Dance: Bubbles, Plankton, and Jellyfish
description:
🌊 Underwater World Animation

This project brings an oceanic scene to life using HTML5 Canvas and JavaScript, simulating a mesmerizing underwater environment.

  • ✨ Features & Effects:

  • 🔵 50 Bubbles – Rise gracefully from the depths.

  • 🌱 100 Plankton Particles – Drift gently across the screen.

  • 🪼 30 Translucent Jellyfish – Float upward with an ethereal motion.

  • 🎲 Randomized Movement – Each element moves with unique velocities for a natural effect.

  • 🔄 Seamless Looping – Objects wrap around canvas edges to maintain continuous animation.

  • 🏎️ Smooth Performance – Uses requestAnimationFrame for fluid rendering.

  • 📏 Responsive Design – Adjusts dynamically to window resizing.

🎯 Who’s It For?

✅ Beginners exploring animation, physics, and randomization in JavaScript.
✅ Creative coders looking for an immersive, calming project.
✅ Anyone interested in interactive web animations.

🔧 Make It Your Own!

🎨 Customize colors, speeds, or object quantities to create your unique underwater scene!

🌊 Dive in and start coding your own animated ocean world! 🚀
